_README: Podcast shows published to R2 (see lib/podcast.js). publicBase = the Worker address serving the bucket (cloudflare/podcast-worker.js). match: which lessons go to the show — by YouTube channel and/or exact column-B series names. autoPublish stays false until the show has been migrated off Spotify for Creators (old episodes imported + 301 redirect done), so nothing is published twice.
